# Historical save fixtures

These JSON files were generated by the actual `createInitialGame` / `advanceWeek` exports at the following committed engine versions. They contain fictional starter-game data only.

| Save version | Source commit |
|---|---|
| 1 | cd77001 |
| 2 | 2d66fb6 |
| 3 | 3a4ec83 |
| 4 | 23a8423 |
| 5 | 1cd91fd |
| 6 | dd44f56 |
| 7 | 9e2e96d |
| 8 | 6e542ea |

Each version includes the untouched week-1 state and a `-week2` state after one real transition. Versions 2–8 queue a Northport store and NOVA research with command `fixture`; version 1 predates order support and advances its calendar. These historical exports were not edited to resemble the current schema. Tests load all 16 fixtures, check preserved money/progress/stock, advance under current rules, save/resume and reproduce the new command replay.

`save-v8-completed.json.gz` is a compact export of a real 104-week national campaign from source `6e542ea`. Its terminal progress, cash, inventory, objectives and checkpoint replay are tested after migration. Compression only reduces fixture size; the save payload is unchanged historical JSON.
